catatan.id: Menu ditata ulang (Fitur utama, Fitur tambahan, Fitur pendukung), tata cara Shalat Jenazah dan Shalat Gerhana lintas mazhab, Dzikir & doa setelah shalat, dan kotak muhasabah yang lebih ringkas.
catatan.su: Ménu ditata deui (Fitur utama, Fitur tambihan, Fitur pangrojong), tata cara Shalat Jenazah sareng Shalat Samagaha lintas mazhab, Dzikir & du'a saba'da shalat, sareng kotak muhasabah anu langkung ringkes.
catatan.jv: Menu dipuntata malih (Fitur utami, Fitur tambahan, Fitur panyengkuyung), tata cara Shalat Jenazah saha Shalat Grahana lintas mazhab, Dzikir & donga sasampunipun shalat, saha kothak muhasabah ingkang langkung ringkes.
catatan.en: Reorganised menu (Main, Additional and Supporting features), funeral and eclipse prayer methods across the schools, after-prayer dhikr & supplications, and a more compact muhasabah box.
